import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 10;
    static final int FLOW_N = 2 * N * N + 2;
    static final int MAXV = FLOW_N + 1;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static String[] grid = new String[N];
    static int[][] sci = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] res = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] inf_time = new int[N][N];
    static int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[][][][] reach = new int[N][N][N][N];

    static ArrayList<Integer>[] g_adj = new ArrayList[MAXV];
    static int[][] cap = new int[MAXV][MAXV];
    static int[][] flow = new int[MAXV][MAXV];
    static int[] cur = new int[MAXV];
    static int[] lvl = new int[MAXV];
    static int[] parent = new int[MAXV];

    static boolean bfs_lvl(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(lvl, -1);
        lvl[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int v : g_adj[u]) {
                if (cap[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0 && lvl[v] == -1) {
                    lvl[v] = lvl[u] + 1;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return lvl[t] != -1;
    }

    static boolean aug_dfs(int u, int t) {
        if (u == t) return true;
        for (int i = cur[u]; i < g_adj[u].size(); ++i) {
            int v = g_adj[u].get(i);
            if (lvl[v] == lvl[u] + 1 && cap[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0 && aug_dfs(v, t)) {
                parent[v] = u;
                return true;
            }
            cur[u] = i + 1;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int c) {
        g_adj[u].add(v);
        g_adj[v].add(u);
        cap[u][v] += c;
    }

    static int max_flow_value(int s, int t) {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfs_lvl(s, t)) {
            Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
                parent[s] = 0;
                if (!aug_dfs(s, t)) break;
                int add = INF;
                for (int v = t, u = parent[v]; v != s; v = u, u = parent[v]) {
                    add = Math.min(add, cap[u][v] - flow[u][v]);
                }
                for (int v = t, u = parent[v]; v != s; v = u, u = parent[v]) {
                    flow[u][v] += add;
                    flow[v][u] -= add;
                }
                ans += add;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int id(int n, int i, int j, boolean right) {
        return i * n + j + (right ? n * n : 0);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        // Initialize arrays
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXV; i++) {
            g_adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(sci[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(res[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(inf_time[i], -1);
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < N; k++) {
                    Arrays.fill(reach[i][j][k], -1);
                }
            }
        }

        int[] explode = new int[2];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') {
                    sb.append('Y');
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    sb.append('Z');
                    explode[0] = i;
                    explode[1] = j;
                } else {
                    sb.append('.');
                    sci[i][j] += ch - '0';
                }
            }
            grid[i] = sb.toString();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch != 'Y' && ch != 'Z') {
                    res[i][j] += ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // BFS from explosion
        inf_time[explode[0]][explode[1]] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{explode[0], explode[1]});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int i = cur[0], j = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int ni = i + dx[d], nj = j + dy[d];
                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n && grid[ni].charAt(nj) == '.' && inf_time[ni][nj] == -1) {
                    inf_time[ni][nj] = inf_time[i][j] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }

        // BFS for reachability
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (grid[i].charAt(j) != '.') continue;
                reach[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                Queue<int[]> q2 = new LinkedList<>();
                q2.add(new int[]{i, j});
                while (!q2.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] cur = q2.poll();
                    int ii = cur[0], jj = cur[1];
                    if (inf_time[ii][jj] == -1 || reach[i][j][ii][jj] < inf_time[ii][jj]) {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int ni = ii + dx[d], nj = jj + dy[d];
                            if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n && grid[ni].charAt(nj) == '.'
                                    && (inf_time[ni][nj] == -1 || reach[i][j][ii][jj] + 1 <= inf_time[ni][nj])
                                    && reach[i][j][ni][nj] == -1) {
                                reach[i][j][ni][nj] = reach[i][j][ii][jj] + 1;
                                q2.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int src = 2 * n * n;
        int sink = src + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (sci[i][j] != 0) add_edge(src, id(n, i, j, false), sci[i][j]);
                if (res[i][j] != 0) add_edge(id(n, i, j, true), sink, res[i][j]);
                for (int ii = 0; ii < n; ++ii) {
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < n; ++jj) {
                        if (reach[i][j][ii][jj] >= 0 && reach[i][j][ii][jj] <= t) {
                            add_edge(id(n, i, j, false), id(n, ii, jj, true), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(max_flow_value(src, sink));
        sc.close();
    }
}
